metric_descriptions.later_requests: Across the 30-day collection window, for jobs included by the current filters. Number of test jobs that started earlier but had later days with requested jobs that did not start. Counts jobs, not individual requests. metric_descriptions.merged_red: Across the 30-day collection window, for jobs included by the current filters. Number of distinct merged pull requests with a recorded failed configured check on the pull request head commit, completed by merge time. A pull request is counted once even if several checks failed. Collection is incomplete; missing records may change this value.
